subject: MAP: POC environment setup - VPC peering, SSO, KMS (Acme)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: alice.chen@acme.com, bob.han@acme.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: POC environment setup - next steps (VPC peering, SSO, KMS)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for carving out the time. Per our MAP discussion, I’m sending the draft milestone for the POC environment setup so we can align on owners, timing, and blockers. Please review and confirm who on your side will own each task and whether any of the dependencies (VPC peering IPs, SSO metadata, KMS integration) require additional approval cycles.

Attached: redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP with milestones) and acme-network-checklist.xlsx (network details we need for peering).

High-level MAP milestone (POC env):
- Milestone: VPC peering and IP allowlist
  - Owner (Acme): Bob Han (Infra)
  - Owner (Redwood): Dev Patel (SE)
  - Target complete: 2026-03-24
  - Dependencies: Exchange of VPC CIDRs, peering request + route propagation, firewall rule for service egress

- Milestone: SSO / SAML configuration
  - Owner (Acme): Sarah Lee (Security) / Alice Chen (CTO)
  - Owner (Redwood): Camila Reyes (Sales) + Dev Patel (SE) for metadata and test accounts
  - Target complete: 2026-03-22
  - Dependencies: IdP metadata, SP initiated vs IdP initiated preference, test user account creation

- Milestone: Secrets / KMS integration (for private key material and API keys)
  - Owner (Acme): Security team (Sarah)
  - Owner (Redwood): Monica Patel (CS) for onboarding + support
  - Target complete: 2026-03-26
  - Dependencies: KMS key access policies, rotation window, E2E test plan

Next concrete asks for Acme:
1) Confirm owners for the three milestones by EOD Tue 2026-03-11
2) Provide VPC CIDRs and preferred peering window (dev network maintenance windows)
3) Share IdP metadata or Okta/Azure AD admin contact for SAML setup

If that timeline looks aggressive, flag which milestone needs extension and I’ll update the MAP and notify the internal team.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Onward to a smooth POC!

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: camila@redwood.ai, bob.han@acme.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, sarah.lee@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-10T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment setup - next steps (VPC peering, SSO, KMS)

Thanks Camila — big thanks to the team for the clear MAP. A few notes from Acme side: 

- We can own VPC peering but need to confirm maintenance windows with NetOps (cc: netops@acme.com). Bob — can you propose two windows next week?
- For SSO, Sarah will own the IdP metadata. Sarah — we use Okta; I’ll ask you to export the SP metadata and share the admin contact. We prefer IdP-initiated flow for now.
- KMS: Security wants to use our existing AWS KMS key. We’ll need Redwood to provide the exact IAM principal ARNs that require decrypt/encrypt access and the expected KMS operations.

Also — can Redwood confirm whether the POC will run in our VPC with peering to Redwood’s managed subnet, or if it will be a private deployment inside our VPC? That affects routing and KMS access.

Can we move the SSO target complete to 2026-03-25 instead of 03-22? Tight on calendar this week.

Thanks —
Alice
CTO, Acme Corp

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment setup - network checklist and peering steps

Hi Bob / NetOps —

Dropping a quick technical checklist for the VPC peering and KMS access so you can share with your infra team. I attached acme-network-checklist.xlsx but paste the key items below.

VPC peering checklist (Redwood POC):
- Provide your VPC CIDR(s) and preferred peer subnet CIDR (so we can confirm no overlap)
- Confirm if cross-account or same account peering; we support both (we will initiate peering request from our side if you prefer)
- Required routes: add route for Redwood managed subnet -> Acme VPC and vice versa; we’ll provide exact route prefixes after CIDR confirm
- IP allowlist: we need to allow outbound to these IP ranges for control plane and telemetry (will provide ranges in follow-up)
- Firewall: ensure egress to our endpoint ports 443 and 8443 is permitted

SSO / SAML notes:
- Send IdP metadata XML (Okta) or provide admin contact; we will configure SP metadata and test with one IdP-initiated account
- Test account: please create one test user with full SSO access and a sample non-admin user for validation

KMS / secrets: 
- If using AWS KMS, please create a key policy statement that allows the Redwood IAM principal (we will provide ARN) to Decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey
- Alternatively we can support passing secrets via a customer-managed Secrets Manager role; we’ll document both flows in the onboarding doc

Attachments: acme-network-checklist.xlsx (network fields), sso-saml-settings.md (SP metadata doc)

Let me know the CIDRs and a couple peering windows and I’ll schedule the peering request.

–Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
